provenance.asset_description: Pathfinder Society The Year of the Battle's Spark: The Darkness Within. The background art is of Zarta Dralneenm dressed in a smart red jacket, as she moves pieces around a battle map while her wayfinder illuminates the scene, with Pathfinders and Andoren soldiers moving in the background of a busy war camp. The overlaying art is of a dark orb wrapped in tree roots
